card.name: Words just before renal impairment
card.fires_on: Words that sit right before 'renal' or 'kidney' impairment, such as 'severe', 'with', 'of' or a closing parenthesis after creatinine clearance values. It appears in dosing text for patients with reduced kidney function.

modes.label: Severity word
modes.description: The word 'severe' (or the end of 'Severe') after 'moderate to' right before renal impairment.
modes.example: Dosage Adjustment for Patients With Moderate to Se<<vere>> Renal Insufficiency —The dose

modes.label: After clearance values
modes.description: A closing parenthesis ending a creatinine clearance or eGFR range, just before 'renal function impairment'.
modes.example: (Cl cr 30 mL/min to 50 mL/min<<)>> renal function impairment, adjustment of the recommended

modes.label: Linking word
modes.description: 'with' or 'of' linking patients or degrees to an upcoming renal impairment term.
modes.example: Dosage Adjustment Regimen for Adult Patients<< with>> Renal Impairment Group Creatinine

card.writes: It makes the model more likely to write kidney or renal (and liver) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the spot in a dosing sentence where 'kidney impairment' is about to be named.
